title: Hamming sphere as a union of support fibers
statement:
Let $\alpha$ be a finite alphabet, let $u \in \alpha^n$ be a word of length $n$, and let $r$ be a natural number. Then the Hamming sphere $S_r(u)$ of radius $r$ centred at $u$ is the union, taken over all $r$-element subsets $S$ of the $n$ coordinate positions, of the support fibers of $u$ over $S$ — that is, the sets of words differing from $u$ at exactly the positions in $S$:
\[
  S_r(u) = \bigcup_{\substack{S \subseteq \{1,\dots,n\} \\ \abs{S} = r}} \{\, v \in \alpha^n : v \text{ and } u \text{ differ in exactly the positions of } S \,\}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: u is a word of length n over the finite alphabet α
r is a natural number (the radius)
replaced:
The Hamming sphere of radius $r$ centred at $u$ equals the union of support fibers over
all size-$r$ subsets of $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$:
\[
  S_r(u) = \bigcup_{S \in \binom{[n]}{r}} \mathrm{supportFiber}(u,S).
\]
